name: The Broken Oath
about: Two houses bound to each other by a royal marriage turn on each other when the bride dies. Every house must choose a side, and whoever wins may not stop at the other's walls.
title: The Broken Oath of {groom.houseName} and {kin.houseName}

beats.speaker: kin
text: The bride {kin} sent to {hall} to seal the peace with {groom.house} is found dead at the foot of the tower stair. {kin} does not believe it was a fall.
{kin}'s daughter, wed to {groom.house} by the King's own blessing, dies in childbed at {hall}. {kin.house} says the midwives were {groom}'s creatures.

memory.kin: My child died at {hall}, in {groom}'s keeping.
memory.groom: {kin} calls my house murderers over my own wife's grave.

court.text: {kin} of {kin.house} stands before the throne in mourning black: "The crown married my blood to {groom.house}, Your Grace. Now my blood is in the ground. What will the crown do?"

options.label: Send the King's justice to {hall} to learn the truth
options.result: The King's justiciar rides to {hall}. Both houses wait for his word, and for now they only wait.

options.label: Hold {groom} to blame
options.result: The King names {groom} responsible. In {hall}, {groom} breaks a cup against the wall.

options.label: Pay for masses and say no more of it (150 gold)
options.result: Masses are sung for the dead bride in every church. {kin} hears them, and is not consoled.

beats.speaker: kin
beats.text: Men without banners burn {groom.house}'s farms from {home} to the river. Everyone knows whose men they are.

court.text: {envoy} of {envoy.house}: "{kin.house} raids {groom.house}'s lands, Your Grace, and {groom} is calling his banners. Stop it now, or choose."

options.label: Command a truce between them (150 gold)
options.hint: both −5 · two years of peace, if they keep it
options.result: The King's peace is proclaimed between {groom.house} and {kin.house}. Neither lord smiles.

options.label: Stand with {groom.house}
options.result: The crown stands with {groom.house}. In {home}, {kin} swears the crown will learn what that costs.

options.label: Stand with {kin.house}
options.result: The crown stands with {kin.house}. {groom} stops sending ravens to Kingsmere.

beats.speaker: groom
beats.text: {groom.house} and {kin.house} are at open war. Their hosts meet in the fields below {home}, and the realm counts the dead.

beats.speaker: groom
beats.text: {groom.house} wins the field. {groom} looks from the smoke of {home} toward Kingsmere, and asks why a crown that could not keep the peace should keep the throne.

court.text: {envoy}: "{groom} has won, Your Grace, and the war has given him a taste for it. Bind him to you now, or face him."

options.label: Grant {groom} lands and honours (400 gold)
options.result: {groom} is made Warden of the realm's marches. {groom.He} kneels, and keeps kneeling.

options.label: Remind {groom} who is King
options.result: The King's letter to {groom} is short. {groom.His} answer is shorter.

beats.speaker: kin
beats.text: {kin.house} takes the field, and {kin} rides into {hall} over its broken gate. Grief has become an army, and armies want more.

court.text: {envoy}: "{kin} has avenged the bride, Your Grace, and is not done. Satisfy {kin.him}, or face {kin.him}."

options.label: Grant {kin} {hall} by royal decree (400 gold)
options.result: By the King's word, {hall} is {kin.house}'s. {kin} kneels in the ruins of {groom}'s hall.

options.label: Order {kin} home
options.result: The King orders {kin} home. {kin} reads the order aloud to {kin.his} captains, and they laugh.

beats.speaker: groom
beats.text: {groom} turns the victorious host toward Kingsmere. A crown that would not choose a side has made itself the next one.

beats.speaker: kin
beats.text: {kin} marches on Kingsmere, saying the crown that married away {kin.his} child owes {kin.him} a reckoning.

beats.speaker: envoy
beats.text: {groom} and {kin} meet at the bride's grave with the King's justiciar between them. Nobody forgives, but nobody draws.

beats.speaker: envoy
beats.text: Bought with honours, the victor keeps the peace the crown could not. {thread} ends with the realm one great house heavier.

beats.speaker: envoy
beats.text: The host that came for Kingsmere is broken before its walls. {thread} ends where it began: in a grave, and a grudge.
With one of the two lords in the ground, {thread} has no one left to carry it.
